_meta.note: first_stage: linearmodels IV2SLS(...).fit(cov_type='robust').first_stage.diagnostics. 'lm_wald_chi2_hc0' is its f.stat column (a chi2(q) Wald on the excluded instruments, HC0, debiased=False). 'f_hc1' = lm_wald_chi2_hc0 / q * (n - L) / n is the exact algebraic conversion to the Stata-convention HC1 first-stage F that tsecon reports; 'f_pval' is scipy.stats.f.sf(f_hc1, q, n - L). hac_two_step: IVGMM with weight_type='kernel', kernel='bartlett', bandwidth = floor(4*(n/100)^(2/9)), cov_type='kernel', debiased=False.

design_a.note: X = [const, w, x] with x endogenous; Z = [const, w, z1, z2]. AR(1) error, rho = 0.6.

design_b.note: X = [const, w, x1, x2] with x1, x2 endogenous; Z = [const, w, z1, z2, z3]. x2 is deliberately weakly instrumented.
